BV1LXJ66ZEuY.ingredients: Squid, lotus root, garlic, green garlic, XO sauce, a little soy sauce and oil.
BV1LXJ66ZEuY.quantities: Amounts, blanching time and stir-frying time are unspecified.
steps: Clean the squid head, remove the eyes and other unwanted parts, wash and cut. Cut lotus root into batons.
Briefly blanch and drain the squid; separately blanch the lotus root.
Fry garlic in a little oil, add squid and cook until lightly yellowed, then add lotus root.
Add chopped green garlic, XO sauce and a little soy sauce. The creator suggests seafood sauce or chu hou sauce if XO sauce is unavailable.
BV1LXJ66ZEuY.missing: Full squid cleaning, lotus-root variety, sauce quantities and times are not supplied. No equal-quantity substitution ratio is given.

BV1LXJ66ZEuY.ingredients: Diaolong beef, black pepper salt, soy sauce, oil, sugar, baking soda, starch, water, peppers, onion, garlic and shiso leaves.
BV1LXJ66ZEuY.quantities: Cut beef about 1 cm thick before cubing. This batch is marinated in the morning for dinner. Exact hours and seasoning proportions are unstated.
steps: Cube beef and mix with black pepper salt, soy sauce, oil, sugar, a little baking soda, starch and water. Refrigerate when preparing well in advance.
Spread beef in a lightly oiled pan and brown one side before turning.
Add peppers, onion and garlic, then shiso near the end and stir fry until finished.
BV1LXJ66ZEuY.missing: Meat weight, baking-soda quantity and cooking time are unknown. Refrigeration is a preparation reminder. Shiso may be omitted as stated, but changes the flavor.

BV1RXJ66oEiW.quantities: Yogurt, berry, nut and cocoa weights and toast time are unspecified.

Toast the bread; add nuts and a little cocoa powder to the yogurt.
Spread some yogurt on the toast as shown. Peanut butter and cream cheese are only alternative suggestions.

Scrape the thicker white pith from the peel and put it in a stewing bowl with ginger, olives, bones and feet. Add water.
Cover and stew, then season with a little salt.

Cover and simmer until ribs and pumpkin are cooked, then reduce to the desired liquid level.
